map.GDM(OGTT 75g)诊断标准器 使用指南: GDM (OGTT 75 g) Diagnostic Criteria Tool User Guide
map.75g口服葡萄糖耐量试验(OGTT)诊断妊娠糖尿病(IADPSG/中国指南): 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) for diagnosing gestational diabetes mellitus (IADPSG/Chinese guidelines)
map.孕 24–28 周做 75g 葡萄糖耐量试验筛查 GDM。: Screen for GDM with a 75 g glucose tolerance test at 24-28 weeks of pregnancy.
map.任一项超标即诊断，确定营养/胰岛素治疗。: Exceeding any one item is enough to diagnose, and nutritional or insulin therapy is then decided.
map.高危人群提前至孕早期筛查。: For high-risk groups move screening forward to the first trimester.
map.：空腹 5.8（>5.3）、1h 10.2（>7.8）、2h 8.5（>6.7）: : Fasting 5.8 (>5.3), 1 h 10.2 (>7.8), 2 h 8.5 (>6.7) mmol/L: all three exceed the limits, diagnosing GDM (grade A2), requiring insulin therapy.
: Fasting 5.1 (<=5.3 normal), 1 h 8.5 (>7.8), 2 h 6.0 (<=6.7): one abnormal item still diagnoses GDM (grade A1), starting with medical nutrition therapy.
map.宫高/腹围与胎儿体重（Hadlock）: Fundal height/abdominal girth and fetal weight (Hadlock)
map.GDM 诊断标准是什么？: What are the GDM diagnostic criteria?
map.75g OGTT 空腹 ≥5.3、1h ≥7.8、2h ≥6.7 mmol/L，: 75 g OGTT: fasting >=5.3, 1 h >=7.8, 2 h >=6.7 mmol/L; meeting any one is enough to diagnose, not all need to be exceeded.
map.A1 和 A2 级怎么分？: How are grades A1 and A2 distinguished?
map.A1 级指饮食运动可控制（空腹达标）；A2 级需加用胰岛素。两者均增加巨大儿与子: Grade A1 means it can be controlled by diet and exercise (fasting on target); grade A2 requires adding insulin. Both raise the risk of macrosomia and pre-eclampsia, and glucose tolerance should be rechecked after delivery.
